en: Whoa, it's huge! Is... that a bird?
Those wings have quite the interesting{SAUT}profile... I'd love to do a sketch of it.
Isn't that more of a flying reptile than it{SAUT}is a bird? The Pteranodon is a pretty well-{SAUT}known specimen from that family.
Hey, wait a sec―be careful! That's{SAUT}an FOE!
What!? Well, looks like we can't just{SAUT}kick back and gawk at it.
So it's not a bird... Still, it's definitely{SAUT}worth observing. I really should{SAUT}sketch it―
Weren't you listening? IT'S AN ENEMY!{SAUT}And an FOE at that!
I suspect we'd be critically injured{SAUT}if we were to get attacked by such{SAUT}massive wings... We should be careful.

...Y'know, all this talk about birds is{SAUT}startin' to make me hungry.{PAGE}What if there was a chicken that size?{SAUT}Couldn't we make a shit-ton of fried{SAUT}chicken out of it?{PAGE}Oh man, how many servings would that{SAUT}even be...
I wonder if fried FOEs would taste{SAUT}good. I feel like they'd give me an{SAUT}upset stomach... but I'm still curious.
Wanna try catching one for a taste test?{PAGE}...On second thought, we could end up{SAUT}being the meal. Make sure you don't{SAUT}get chased down while you pass it by.
